title: Distance to the Boomerang Nebula vs. the ISS (miles)
geography: Deep space vs. low Earth orbit

source.name: Boomerang Nebula distance; International Space Station altitude

notes: The Boomerang Nebula is about 5,000 light-years away, roughly 2.94x10^16 miles. The ISS orbits at about 250 miles altitude. Rounded for on-screen clarity.
